property_summary: For any caller and any guess hash, once a caller successfully lockInGuess(...) when they had no pending guess, the stored guess and block for that caller remain unchanged by any subsequent lockInGuess(...) call from the same caller before settle() — the mutant that removes the 'no existing guess' check allows overwriting that stored guess/block, violating this invariant.
change_summary: Remove the check that the caller has no existing guess, allowing callers to overwrite an existing stored guess and block number.
